feedback.problem: Consider a linear transformation $T:{R}^{5}\to {R}^{5}.$ If $\text{nullity}(T)=2$ then $\text{rank}(T)=$
feedback.worked_solution:
According to the rank-nullity theorem, if $T:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n},$ then

$$
\text{rank}(T)+\text{nullity}(T)=n.
$$

For the given transformation, we have $n=5.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(T)+\text{nullity}(T) & =n \\ \text{rank}(T)+2 & =5 \\ \text{rank}(T) & =5-2 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
